As the chapters are added for you to explore, Gods and Nemesis: of Ghosts from Dragons will unravel into a multiplayer open sandbox RPG. One thing you will notice up front is every asset is crafted from scratch. Future chapters will include a survival-based world that will invite you and your friends to adventure the main storyline, find side quests, unravel secrets, or create and play your own epic quests within a truly alien environment. Once you get used to the asymmetrical world with its fresh layout within the first chapters, future chapters will be released that include giving an open world experience. Are you an explorer or dungeon crawler? Are you a survivalist or crafter? Maybe you want to begin creating your own quests as a modder-- the future chapters will give you incredible options. 
 
Features of this first chapter  
• 1st chapter will be approximately one hour of average play  
• Engaging storyline  
• Intro to the alien world with in-game tutorials  
• Several Side quests and Easter Eggs

title: In Celebration of Violence
description: A fantasy action roguelike of exploration and murder. Live, kill, die, improve, live again.

title: BattleTime
description:
Take a role of a true general of a real army. Join the battle, capture
enemies’ castles and raise the power of your army. Lead your clan to the
victory!

title: Last Stitch Goodnight
description: Last Stitch Goodnight is a side scrolling action adventure that embraces a new mythology. After a near-death experience, you are kidnapped by a doctor who is experimenting on people who satisfy certain criteria. Escape will require new weapons, powers, and a strong stomach for bad science.

title: PostCollapse
description: PostCollapse is a survival simulation game set after the collapse of civilization. Gather items from the ruins, construct tools, grow your own food, go fishing and hunting. Single player only. No Zombies.

title: Fire Arrow Plus
description: Fire Arrow and Fire Arrow X are time attack style shooters with a heavy emphasis on scoring. Otherwisely, you can call them coffee break shmups.

title: The Last Weekend
description: The Last Weekend let's the player play one out of four characters to experience a weekend that they'll never forget.

title: ZombLabs
description: ZombLabs is an action packed Horror-Survival FPS. Fight your way through an epic battle against endless waves of zombies. Get ready for a ridiculous amount of fun!

title: Triple X Tycoon
description: Triple X Tycoon is a simulation game in which the player explores the world of adult entertainment from the inside.

title: Aircraft War X
description: The game is dedicated to the air battle.

title: Domino VR
description: Domino VR is a new and simple VR game for the HTC Vive designed to let you experience that "nooooo, they're falling!" feeling all over again. You can build whatever you want in a fun sandbox environment.

title: Project Lounge
description: Project Lounge is a 3D social game that encourages people to socialize in enviroments full of interactable objects such as drawboards, vinyl players and even arcade machines!

title: Painted Legend
description:
Imagine that one day, all the worlds that you have created on paper - live.
Brave knights, fearsome dragons and terrible monsters, they all live on the page of your notebook.

title: Ball of Wonder
description: Come with us to the magnicifent world of circuses.

title: Flat Heroes
description: Flat Heroes is a minimalist super intense local multiplayer game with special care put into the game-feel and polishing of every detail in a trendy graphic experience. The game includes multiple cooperative and competitive modes for 1-4 players and features squares!

title: Won't You Be My Laser?
description: An 80s-themed puzzle game in which you avoid the line of sight of lethal gun turrets... while acquiring pick-up sticks.

title: Broken Armor
description: A knight exiled from his kingdom must find the holy grail if he is to return.

title: Meteor Crush VR
description:
Protect our planet from incoming meteoroids!

Use your VR controllers to crush every one coming your way.

title: Mini Z Racers Turbo
description: Engage in a fantastic mini race in unexpected places. Choose your favorite ZRacer and fight your way through 16 tracks in 4 awesome worlds. Grab ZBags and unleash power-ups on your foes!

title: Escape Lizards
description: Escape Lizards is a challenging, tricky platformer where you must navigate the lizards' eggs across increasingly precarious platforms to get to the finishing bell. You can not directly control the egg however; instead you must guide it across the level by tilting and manipulating the world.

title: Beerman
description:
Take charge of the caped deliverer and help Boston's
finest foil The Society Of The Ninth over land, sea and
air!

title: Handsome Mr. Frog
description: Jump, lick, and spit your way through four worlds in a new-school arcade adventure starring the nominal Handsome Mr. Frog, a good looking fellow whose hat was jacked by a bunch of unattractive normies.

title: Qubic
description: Qubic is a retro-like turn-based puzzle game in which your task is to solve the labyrinth, collect the stars to unlock next level, avoid enemies/traps and... save your qubic green ass!

title: Super VR Trainer
description: Unleash your power shooting your opponents with your bow, deflecting blaster shots with your laser swords, surviving an infested hospital, being the king of basket or surfing with your hoverboard. Welcome to Super VR Trainer!

title: You Have 10 Seconds
description: You Have 10 Seconds is a fast paced arcade style platformer game with over 40 levels.

title: Black Sand Drift
description: For over 300 years, the five planets of the Kotiro galaxy have struggled under the heavy hand of maniacal, mechanical bots called Spiral. As the metallic army's relentless pursuit of the resource Black Sand begins ramping up exponentially, a few brave heroes decide to fight back.

title: Gone In November
description: Coming home after visiting your doctor for the last time, you are told that you only have three more days to live. A sequence of short memory fragments flashing through as you try to run away from what you have done.

title: Vindictive Drive
description: Vindictive Drive is an Action/Stealth game about Arris Fern's cold blooded revenge against her father, the president of the most powerful nation, for the assassination of her mother. Consumed by hatred, Arris will use the most cruel methods at her disposal to achieve her goal.

title: Island Simulator 2016
description: Don't be fooled by the name, Island Simulator 2016 is so much more than your average simulator! With three modes currently available (and more to come!) you'll have hours of fun exploring lands in Survival Mode, Hunting Mode, and Campaign Mode!

title: Zzzz-Zzzz-Zzzz
description: When you sleep, you are dreaming. Some dreams are beautiful and vivid, the others are strange, and the rest of them are horrible... We've having them all the night, and then wake up and forget them. But what if one day your "awakening" would be a difficult task? Could you find a way out of the dreams and wake up?

title: Zombitatos the end of the Pc master race
description:
Welcome to the apocalyptic world of Zombitatos!

You are going to play as 2 survivors in this comedy point and click adventure! There are puzzle elements to keep your brain entertain!, lots of easter eggs, a unique style of humor, and an interactive storyline!

Are you ready to survive?

title: BlackSmith HIT
description: BlackSmith HIT – Hit the iron when it is hot! And show who is the real blacksmith!

title: Dragon Knight
description: Dragon Knight is a RPG in which you play as the worst knight in the kingdom sent on the classic quest- Take the magic sword, save the monster, slay the girl—err, no, was it…

title: Bacon Tales: Between Pigs and Wolves
description: Bacon Tales is a 2D side view tower defense game inspired by the famous tale “The Three Little Pigs”. The player must defend the Pig’s Village against the wolves. Choose a hero to help you on your journey and fortify the village to get it more resistant and able to gather more resources.

title: Aussie Sports VR
description: The Aussie Sports VR experience provides unprecedented access to Australian sport and elite athletes in support of the Australian Sports Diplomacy Strategy 2015-18.

title: Treasure of a Blizzard
description: "Treasure of blizzard" is a fantasy themed visual novel inspiring with beautiful arts and interesting game characters. The fate of the protagonist completely depends on your choice. Probably your character may meet his partner in life; however he may also meet the end of his life.

title: $1 Ride
description:
$1 Ride is a casual game with a fast paced, timing and reflex testing game-play style.
Travel through space at warp speed! Collect power ups to increase your speed or risk your fuel to collect money, missiles and more.

title: Strategy & Tactics: Dark Ages
description: Dark Ages is a turn-based strategy game set in the violent world of an alternate Middle Ages. Vikings against war elephants, musketeers against the Mongol cavalry, ancient phalanx legions against crusaders; the deadliest armies in history clashing in bloody war.

title: Galer: Plague of Heroes
description: A new and innovative game combining the old school RPG's from yesteryear with the survival horror element in a zombie apocalypse. Travel the world in search of survivors while learning the truth behind the zombie outbreak. Does God actually exist? Or is something more sinister awaiting....

title: Draconic Order VR
description: Virtual Reality RPG Survival game in Alpha for the HTC Vive! Discover mysterious tomes, written in different race's native tongue. These can be transcribed at various portals around the island. Holding the items in your hand when near the portal will cause them to 'react', meaning a tome can be transcribed after a few seconds when opened. Learn various spells, and summon legendary Guardians to aide you in Battle. Seek out the epic weapons of fallen Heroes once lost to the Island. You will need Guardians to take down the 4 big bosses you learn of from the notes in the Prison cells beneath the island.

title: Scrap Garden: The Day Before
description: A new chapter of charming 3D platformer about the little rusty robot C4N who unwittingly finds himself in the midst of momentous events in Robo Land. In order to solve the new riddle, Canny will once again need to run and jump a lot, solve puzzles, and fight against enemies who are much bigger and stronger than he is.

title: Skipchaser
description: Skipchaser is a story-driven sci-fi fantasy shooter with procedural missions, deep weapon customization and action/adventure elements.

title: MaxControl
description: The first Base-building, RTS, Shooter hybrid in Cryengine.

title: MiniBotz
description: Players take control of Robots loaded to the gears with weapons and bad attitudes. In their struggle for dominance, these robots fight one another or hordes of cockroaches, CandyCubz, and BoomCubez for control of the map. These little Botz, however, are fighting in ridiculous environments. From kitchen tables to dirty bathrooms the MiniBotz will stop at nothing to reign supreme.

title: Haeven
description: Explore fantastical interpretations of different parts of the mind including the Hippocampus, Ego, and more! Battle against your oppressive Subconscious as you struggle for control of your mind.

title: Sneak Thief
description: Sneak Thief is a first person, shooter, strategy, stealth and puzzle game that lets you choose how you want to play. Use your wits and expertise to setup and perform heists whether that be by using brute force to smash your way through or by getting away without making a sound.

title: CrapsVR
description:
Play Craps in VR!Experience realistic Vegas action of CrapsVR!  Strap on your SteamVR headset, place bets, take odds, and throw some dice!  The most authentic craps simulator in VR.
Fast-paced casino action!
Vegas odds for all bets!
Test out new betting strategies before you head to Vegas!
Realistic casino environment!

title: ROD: Revolt of Defense
description: Explore a random generated space. Find artifacts and treasure maps. Build and develop your base on a flying platform. Attack or defend against enemies and save the universe!

title: Project Xinatra
description: Project Xinatra is an action game inspired in the old classic arcade games. You will remember those classics games while you are killing hordes of enemies.

title: RollerForce
description: RollerForce is a high intensity VR Roller coaster/shooter mix. Battle your way through 10 tracks in two world locations, SHOOT TO SURVIVE!

title: Party Panic
description: Party Panic is a crazy online and local-multiplayer party game. Compete against your friends in 15+ rapid fire minigames, or race through the brutal Gauntlet. There is even a built in drinking game! You'll laugh, you'll cry, it's stupid.

title: Archmage Rises
description: Experience the freedom normally only found in a tabletop RPG. Empowered with magic, you will create your own story, and experience real consequences from the decisions you make. Will you be the world’s savior . . . or its destroyer? The choice is yours.

title: Quip Anomaly
description: Quip Anomaly is a deep space dodge 'em up game. Guide Virnu to dodge hazards, acquire research, and obtain power ups. As you unlock each level, you will learn more about Virnu and her story.

title: Dinosaur Forest
description: Dinosasur Forest is a fast paced chaotic first person wave-based shooter that pits players equipped with some basic weapons against species currently inhabiting the Unknown Planet.

title: Twisty's Asylum Escapades
description: Take an exciting journey with Twisty, the floating brain monster, as he battles his way out of an insane asylum in this hilariously bizarre, action/adventure game.

title: Goo Saga: HD Edition
description:
Goo Saga is a platform adventure game where the player guides an elastic creature named Goo in a perilous journey to find his creator – and with him, the mysterious purpose of his own creation.
Will Goo succeed? Puzzles, deadly traps and an army of foes in a labyrinthine underwater lab block his way. Goo’s destiny is in the player’s hands.

title: Downward
description:
Venture into the haunted wilds with Gable, a little owl, as she sets out to rekindle the dormant relics of a land long abandoned to ruin.

Puzzle, fight, and fly your way through the long lost gauntlets, and spectral denizens of the fearful Deep Wilds.

Flying is a core feature of traversing the environment in Down Ward. The unique flight system allows unlimited airtime, but requires forward momentum and skillful maneuvering to maintain lift.

Like the physics of real flight, as long as Gable is moving forward, she can gain lift.
She can stay in the air as long as she has the room to maneuver around obstacles and maintain forward airspeed.

Specters of the Deep Wilds abound, and obstacles, both puzzly and precisiony await!

All in-game graphics are composed of 4 colors, and there are many 4-color palettes to choose from.

title: CoLab
description: Do you have what it takes to solve more than 100 challenging puzzles in the first virtual reality show while being 'advised' by our witty narrator to entertain the audience?

title: Pong Champion VR
description:
For the HTC Vive Owner who is looking for the best VR Ping Pong experience.  
 
'Pong Champion VR' is a table tennis simulation with a state-of-the-art physics engine that feels just like the real thing.  
 
Unlike other virtual reality ping pong games, Pong Champion VR allows you to put spin on the ball and perform kill shots against your opponent.  
 
Train your serve and test your skills against multiple difficulty levels. You'll never have to chase balls again!

title: Going Up?
description: Because who wouldn't want to get trapped in an elevator with a yappy little dude? Check out this totally unique remake of the old-school RPGs. Run amok in a tower full of gold, weapons, magic, and of course--enemies!

title: Sky Valley
description: Sky Valley has unique style and does not look like anything else. It makes you escape from the daily routine and fully enjoy the flight. Go forward towards your dream.

title: Unfazed
description: Unfazed is a fascinating 3D FPS Game that allows maximum control of a competent combatant in a hostile enviromment. The gamer can fully utilize a great variety of up to 25 different weapons including rifles, semi-automatic guns, grenades, knives, revolvers and DMRs.He fights his way through zombies and giant spiders among others to emerge victorious.

title: The Wizard's Lair
description: Dare you challenge The Wizard's Lair? Take on 30 floors of devious traps, deadly monsters and destructive weapons!

title: Bicyclism EP
description: Bicyclism EP is a physics based party game for up to 4 split-screen players. Play as your favorite bicycle and compete in traditional bicycle games like racing, jousting, soccer, space mushroom hunting, wrestling, etc.

title: Scéal
description: The spirit of a little girl wanders the pages of a magical story book, searching for her lost memories, painting the world around her as she uncovers the fragments of her forgotten life.

title: Baseball Mogul Diamond
description:
Baseball Mogul® Diamond is the 18th version of the "best baseball simulation you can buy" (PC Gamer).

The groundbreaking franchise that revolutionized sports games continues to redefine the way you run and manage your favorite baseball team.

title: The Superfluous
description: "The Superfluous" A cave-diving, sci-fi, rogue-lite, platformer with jet packs and lots of explosions. Help stop an apocalyptic asteroid on collision course with Earth. Lead a squad to the center of the asteroid and blast it into space dust.

title: Tesla's Tower: The Wardenclyffe Mystery
description: Fix the past, save the color!

title: The Wire
description: "The Wire" is a casual puzzle game with plenty of levels, which is designed to suit the needs and abilities of players of all ages. Play with the electronic background music, you just need to move the controller to go forward. The most import thing is making sure it is going on the track. To win a level, you just need to reach the end point before time up. That's it. We hope you guys enjoy it as much as we do!

title: Lily's Epic Quest
description: Lily's grandfather was a digger for hidden gems. Join Lily on her epic quest for the ultimate treasure, fame and glory

title: Club Manager 2017
description: Club Manager 2017 lets you take on the role of an ambitious up-and-coming football manager once again.  Start your career with a team in the German league or one of four international leagues.

title: Strike Squadron: Caracará
description:
Story-driven 2D Space sim inspired by 90's space sims.

You are not an ace pilot, nor is your squadron the best of the best. You just want to do your job, whatever the cost.

title: Super Rock Blasters!
description: Ready up a space ship and destroy your friends in this frenetic multiplayer Asteroids reimagining!  In Super Rock Blasters, up to 4 players will wheel around space rocks, dodge ricocheting bullets and blast each other into tiny neon colored giblets.

title: Diamond Joyce and the Secrets of Crystal Cave
description: Diamond Joyce and the Secret of Crystal Cave is an action puzzle game with quest for long-lost treasures buried in pitch black caves, pyramids and temples of ancient civilizations.

title: GooCubelets: The Void
description: How can something as empty as a void be filled with puzzles and mysteries? Well, the answer is simple - this is GooCubelets! 50 completely new puzzles in 50 levels for everyone to enjoy and train their brains. Can you solve them all and abscond the Void?

title: Let Them Come
description: Let Them Come is a fast paced pixel art shoot ‘em up. Twitchy trigger fingers and focused battle tactics are the order of the day as wave after wave of alien-like creatures try to take you down.

title: The Crystal Nebula
description: Fly your spaceship from wormhole to wormhole, navigating dangerous space station obstacle courses and collecting crystals from the wreckage of fallen enemies. The Crystal Nebula demands your highest dexterity and accuracy in order to shoot and dodge your way through its waves of opposition!

title: Fire Farm VR
description:
Uh-oh, looks like those three little egg cookin’ piggies are up to no good! What seemed like a normal breakfast in the barn, suddenly took a turn for the worse. Now, as the big red barn is engulfed in flames, the farm animals need your help as they scram to safety! Load up your slingshot with fresh-filled water balloons and step into FireFarm VR!

FireFarm VR is an action packed, single-player, Indie developed shooter where the player is equipped with a water balloon slingshot and has one goal: save the farm animals. Players will rescue wave after wave of animals with increasing difficulty, in an attempt to restore peace on the farm.

title: Glaive
description: Each map is fairly small and should only take a few minutes to beat, but also should be fairly challenging on UV and be fun to blast through.

title: Anyland
description: Anyland is an open virtual reality universe to create your home, chat with others, explore & live in! Made from the ground up for VR, and shaped by all of us together.

title: Trimmer Tycoon
description: Trimmer Tycoon is a shop management game with simulator elements. You start off with an empty shop which you can later expand to a bigger and better one. Customers find you quickly and your job is to satisfy their beardy dreams to the best of your abilities. Attract more customers by decorating your shop and handle rush hours with skilled employees. The customers expect accurate shaves and colors, but you can't take too long; the clock is ticking - you need to make enough money to pay rent!

title: Switch: Or Die Trying
description: Switch: Or Die Trying is a cute yet highly challenging platformer where you dynamically switch forms to try and win over your lost alphabet friends.

title: Shop Heroes
description: Brand new fantasy shop simulation & RPG game packed with endless adventure!

title: Dragon Bros
description: Robots are everywhere, destroying the place you used to call home! The only cure for this terrible mess is to wipe out those cranky machines with bullets and big explosions! Play as a young dragon in this 2D retro run & gun adventure in co-op or solo. Free your Dragon-mom from the evil Mechaliches!

title: My Lil' Donut
description: Before you lies your Donut. You can pull and twist it, snap and swish it. You have a whole arsenal of settings, presets and tools to play with. You can freeze it, relax it, save any contortion to be viewed later. You can even rip it apart so it returns to the void from which it came. Yet your Donut is still a being and you must show it respect. Make sure you caress it, and let it know that at the end of all this, you Know what it is, what it can become; all of its jiggles and imperfections. Build a relationship, because at the end, connection is the reason we are here.

title: Elves Adventure
description: Fate of the hero is in our hands, he is a stranger on new planet. He had occasion to return, but finally he stays and decides to help local people.

title: Secrets of Me
description: "Secrets of Me" is a game where, after getting plastic surgery, you can stalk a hot guy to get him to fall in love with you! If you're tired of typical otome games, then this one's for you!

title: Gakuen Club
description: Gakuen Club is a school life love story that begins when you discover a secret at your academy, setting off a chain of events that you never imagined. Enjoy the different distinct and unique characters along with their own stories and wonderful voices.

title: The Charming Empire
description: The Charming Empire is a dating simulation game set in the Taisho Roman era of Japanese history.

title: Ghost Pursuit VR
description: Ghost Pursuit VR is a new generation Pac-Man, with a touch of Bomberman. Playable in virtual reality and also on a classic screen.

title: Valentino Rossi the Game Compact
description: Valentino Rossi The Game Compact enables you to choose all the official riders, teams and tracks in the 2016 MotoGP season.

title: Tribe of Pok
description: Tribe Of Pok is a tribal survival strategy game featuring a deeply simulated environment. You manage a tribe of hunter-gatherers, helping them survive and thrive in a savage world.

title: King of Spin VR
description: Shane Warne King of Spin is a fun, pick up and play batting game for the HTC Vive where you can have a quick hit with your friends, or even simulate a full team in a one-day match innings, facing 50 overs at various difficulty from Shane Warne!

title: Dig 4 Destruction
description:
The first of its kind! A first for VR! An intense online multiplayer deathmatch game where you must dig through the earth and excavate weapons to battle your enemies!
*Coming Soon to the Oculus Touch!

title: Hospitalize
description:
Find the most effective way to construct and manage a hospital. Build your hospital smart and avoid excess time and resources consumed by examining your patients unnecessary. You can choose to micromanage your patients or hope that your doctors are able to identify the cause of their symptoms. 
 
Aim to avoid malpractice, and become the best hospital administrator in the world.

title: Roomscale Tower
description: Roomscale Tower is a photogrammetric experience built for the HTC Vive. Become a knight of the Middle Ages and leave in search of wealth through towers filled with traps. Fight skeleton's army in intense survival mode. Climb mountains, catch piglets, throw knifes or relax at the tavern.

title: Zombie Camp
description:
Zombie Camp is a room-scale VR shooter!
Experience 360 degree virtual reality shooting in a desperate attempt to protect your campsite from crazed ZOMBIES!!

title: Neo-Now!
description: Explore wonderful worlds and battle Several creatures in search of his destiny

title: N0-Exit
description: The game tells the story of a miner who was trapped in an iron mine after a strong earthquake , now he fights contro many monsters to survive and find a way out .

title: Mahluk: Dark demon
description: Mahluk is a hack and slash platformer game with pixel-art style graphics and retro style addicting gameplay.

title: Sword of Fireheart - The Awakening Element
description: Walk through a vast world facing a varied horde of creatures that need to be exterminated and puzzles that need to be solved, then bring peace back to your village.

title: The Fallen Kingdom
description: The kingdom is at war and you are the wizard who can save it! Get ready for a 2D isometric journey with spells, combat, bosses, an incredible soundtrack that accompanies the simple, yet epic story!

title: Invasion
description: We want you to experience the dreadful emptiness of space and the tension of the obscurity of aliens.

title: Starship Disco
description: Starship Disco is a music-driven rhythm shooter with user music imports. Blast aliens to the beat in VR with 1 or 2 hands with HTC Vive or Oculus Touch controllers.

title: Fall of Freya
description: Sci-Fi Survival Shooter created by a small indie team. Powered by the Unreal Engine 4.

title: Void
description: In this epic quest you must reach the end by going through black holes. Try to avoid all the traps, solve all the mind-bending puzzles and escape form the powerful bosses. OH... And one more thing .... secrets are everywhere.

title: Saving Harmony
description: It is March 15, 1920 and the town of Nikolayevsk-on-Amur has been overrun by mad men killing and burning everything in sight. You are the last survivor of the Japanese expeditionary force in Siberia. You must fight to survive and in the end find a way to save Harmony.

title: Splash Blast Panic
description: SPLASH BLAST PANIC is a multiplayer competitive party game where you must shoot, ram, dodge and overall bully your opponents outside the screen with a variety of watergun-based weaponry. Inspired by old arcade titles as well as newer competitive party games, ruin all your friendships in a variety of stage which may or may not have various level of gimmicks that could backhand you if you're not careful, or tell that person you always despised your true feelings with waterbomb launchers, bubble prisons, watergun sentries, reflective shields and more !

title: Elven Assassin
description:
Take a bow and kill hordes of orcs in the epic town defense game. You can play alone to conquer the leaderboards or unite with other assassins in online co-op mode.
PS. Be careful to avoid massive axes thrown at you by orc warriors.

title: The Life of Greather
description: You are just a simple farmer, your wife has not returned. Venture across this open medieval world and find her.

title: Patterna
description: Patterna is a logic puzzle game for people who think that HexCells is far too easy. It features a highly customizable random level generator, a level editor, more than 70 levels, and an enchanting minimalist soundtrack by Alex Cottrell.

title: Candy Smash VR
description: Satisfy your hacking and slashing needs in colorful and mushy candy world. Experience the most fun you can have with VR and HTC Vive controllers smashing stuff!

title: Star Tactics
description:
Star Tactics is a hardcore turn-based tactics game all about space fleets battles.
20+ hours of gameplay, randomized battles, two campaigns. Infinite tactical situations.

title: Detective Hank and the Golden Sneeze
description: When the Golden Sneeze is stolen from the Museum of Ancient History, it’s up to you, Detective Hank, to catch the thief. That will not be easy, as the culprit changes every new game. Puzzle your way through this steampunk themed, interactive whodunnit visual novel and bring the thief to justice!

title: Endless Fables: The Minotaur's Curse
description: Face off against the Minotaur!

title: 3..2..1..Grenades!
description: 3..2..1..Grenades! is a snowball fight with high explosives. Help save Grenades Co from the terrible monster it's unleashed by yourself or with up to 4 people!

title: Russian VR Coasters
description: Collection of Russian VR Coasters. Experience 4 types of different VR Coasters that will bring you new amazing impressions!

title: The Janitor
description: Max Taylor, a janitor, who is send to an abandoned asylum once guarded by the army. When he enters he gets in contact with a went-wrong experiment of the government and has to worry about his live! On the way to exit he has to struggle with the horrific manlike creature!

title: Tank Hero VR
description: Tank Hero VR is developed by Edougame and also the first oriented VR platform tank game!!! During the battle players are placed in the real tank cockpit and control the tank to flight with others and it's really a fantasic game experience! Come and enjoy the Tank journey!!!

title: Avalon: The Journey Begins
description: Depart your home world of Avalon to begin the longest journey ever attempted by mankind, to find the end of the universe. What is at the end of the universe and where is the end of the universe? This is where your journey begins.

title: Quest for Glory Collection
description: The world of Gloriana, with all its wonderful diversity, awaits you.

title: Gunnihilation
description: Ultraviolent bullet-hell platformer Gunnihilation is dual stick 16-bit mayhem that fuses several forms of 2D shoot 'em up, from run-and-gun classics like Contra and Metal Slug, to the arena-based slaughter of Smash TV.

title: Calm Down, Stalin
description: Calm Down, Stalin is a game where you directly control your hands to threaten your enemies with nuclear weapons by moving your finger closer to The Button while signing important state papers, answering phone, dealing with your subordinates and most of all - fighting the stress of your position by smoking your pipe and any other available means!

title: Slider Quest
description: Slider Quest is an immersive puzzler with over 40 levels designed exclusively for Virtual Reality. Just as you would in real life, use your hands to grab and move objects around the virtual world as you help guide the ball to the basket. Move blocks and panels to create a path for the ball to follow.

title: Legends of Azulgar
description: Legends of Azulgar is a Sci-Fi Action oriented Strategy Roleplaying game that puts you in command of a space ship, space station and a fleet in a massive sandbox universe. The game immerses the player in a fully interactive environment and a world rich in lore and Legends.

title: Heroes from the Past: Joan of Arc
description: Save the day in this epic story of honor and courage

title: The Agency of Anomalies: Mystic Hospital - Collector's Edition
description: Explore haunted military hospitals!

title: Off the Record: The Italian Affair - Collector's Edition
description: Catch a ‘Foxy’ thief!

title: Echoes of the Past: Kingdom of Despair - Collector's Edition
description: Escape the witch's kingdom!

title: Fairy Maids
description: Become the cleaning fairy!

title: Black Hat Cooperative
description: Black Hat Cooperative is a two player coop stealth game. One player is in VR, sneaking past enemies and collecting treasure. The other player is on the computer and keyboard, with access to a full view of the map and hacking superpowers. Work together to survive and complete the levels! Local multi-player supported.

title: Red is Dead
description:
Red is Dead is an intense action game with a randomized obstacle course containing over 120 levels. While playing this game you get an insane rush while being heavily amused. There are many physics in the game that you can interact with. Overcome insanely hard levels and beat your personal high score.
Red objects make you die when you collide with them.
Black objects are neutral.
Blue objects move when they collide or are close enough to the player.
Have fun!

title: Dungeon Punks
description: Dungeon Punks is an old-school arcade beat-em-up, packed with new features like tag-team fighting gameplay and an RPG adventure! Nothing beats the thrill of freeze-blasting foes with a genie, as your dwarf tags in to incinerate them with bombs and napalm.

title: Frantic Freighter
description: This game is optimized for VR, but does not require it. Frantically attempt a delivery across space in a freighter. Unfortunately, your ship is constantly falling apart. Trade spare parts, find stashes & evade pirates along the way. Succeed to unlock challenges!

title: Angels & Demigods
description: VR capable sci-fi visual novel which takes place in the distant future on Enceladus.

title: MiniLaw: Ministry of Law
description:
Roam the dystopian future city of New Babel, Mankind's Last Hope, in search of crimes in progress.
Use lethal weapons, non-lethal force, and diplomacy to take down bad guys.

title: Samurai Wars
description: Immerse yourself in the wonderful world of 12th-century Japan. Become a samurai. At your disposal is only the sword, so TAKE THE FIGHT!

title: Maraiyum: Rise of the Setting Sun
description:
The coup has finally come!

After the disastrous rule of the previous Emperor, the Imperial army have placed you, a distant relative with no training, on the throne. With rebellions, religious insurgency, widespread famine, and a rapidly dwindling treasury, time is not on your side. Over the course of one year you must decide how best to spend your time, training your skills to enable you to make the right decisions to restore the once great Empire of the Setting Sun to its former glory, or condemn it and you to the dustbin of history.

title: Superstar
description: A short analog horror parody game.

title: Deserted: The Story of Peter
description: Deserted lets you play as Peter, you will slowly get to know him and uncover the mystery that seems to be driving him mad, relive his memories and try to understand who is truely important to you and who is just a horrible nightmare

title: Invisible Mind
description: Go on a trip around the worlds created by your own mind and learn yourself.

title: Death's Life
description: Now you’re the new apprentice for Death. And it's your job to help gather souls. Only thing is, you can't just go and kill people to get the souls, it has to look natural. Like an accident. And that means setting up bottles, knives, brooms, and other regular objects in such a way as to create deadly chain reactions. Try a day in Deaths Life. Dying has never been more fun!

title: Anicon: Animal Complex - Cat's Path
description:
Includes the Cat's route.

A romance, comedy, fantasy visual novel filled with adventures, misadventures, adorable animals, brother conflicts, circus cleaning, collecting puzzle pieces, and more — in one package!

title: Drayt Empire
description:
Drayt Empire is a classic RPG.
Ronarke and Drayt, best Friends on an adventure to seek out and find the lost forbidden City of Rahland. On their travels they will encounter many challenges which will test their friendship and strength.

title: Interstellar Logistics Inc
description: Interstellar Logistics Inc. is an action puzzle game. The player shoots an object from Point A to Point B using the gravity of planets, stars, and black holes while hitting certain points along the way. There's a lot more to the game, but that is the basic idea.

title: Orczz
description:
Orczz is a fantasy tower defense game set in the fantasy Kingdom of Whiteleaf, famous for its delicious honey wine – the mead.
The player controls the Knight Order of the Mug, protectors of Whiteleaf and the mead, who are once again called to defend the land against an invading horde of orcs.
The game features a story driven campaign with 6 different areas, minigames, achievements and 40 different units.

- No flying cows in the final version.
- More alcohol than you can shake a beer mug at.
- 40+ different units - and half of them are green.
- Great minigames - watch out for anvils!
- Superior graphics - forget ugly 3D, we're ugly in 2D.
- Adorably violent - fun for all the family.
- Child-friendly (yes, even the bits with booze!)

title: Monsters' Den: Book of Dread
description: Enter the Monsters' Den, a place of endless adventure, battle and reward! Lead your party of four heroes through each level of the ever-changing dungeon, fighting in turn-based battles and hunting for that elusive rare loot. The web-game classic comes to Steam!

title: You Deserve
description: You Deserve is an horror indie game in which you will experience a bullying story about revenge, starring a teenager called Amy who is lost in a world that she doesn’t know and her only objective is to escape from it without getting murdered.

title: Super Markup Man
description: Super Markup Man is the ultimate fun way to practice web development and learn the basics of HTML and CSS. No coding skills needed!

title: ATV Quadracer Ultimate
description: Experience crazy races at break-neck speed! In „ATV Quadracer Ultimate“ you can prove your driving skills on several tracks while doing impressive jumps and tricks at high speeds.

title: Tangled Up!
description: "Tangled Up" is the story of two electric charges "Positive Charge" & "Negative Charge" who are paired by an electric string. One day the string that bonds them together gets tangled up! and they're unable to unite!

title: Airport Fire Department: The Simulation
description: Move out with your team and experience tense missions. As a member of the airport fire department, you and your team extinguish massive aircraft fires and beat a path through the flickering flames.

title: Firefighters: The Simulation
description: You and your team will experience the exciting work of the professional fire brigade, surviving realistic missions where you extinguish house fires, salvage and neutralize extremely toxic and hazardous substances, and accomplish many other fascinating tasks.

title: Roadworks - The Simulation
description: This simulation transports you to the varied work in road construction. Re-enact typical assignments and scenarios on country roads and motorways. Get to work with the asphalt mill, steamroller, marking machine and many more special vehicles.

title: Plant Fire Department: The Simulation
description: Welcome to the factory fire defence! You and your colleagues will combat fire in an attempt to stop its destructive power. Solve seemingly impossible tasks, and use your equipment and special vehicles as you fight the flames.

title: Professional Construction: The Simulation
description: Immerse yourself in the sprawling and fascinating world of road construction! Experience life on the construction site like the pros, and use heavy equipment and massive machinery.

title: Strike.is: The Game
description: Load your gun and dominate the best multiplayer mobile shooter game!

title: The Multidimensional Underwear Drawer
description: The Multidimensional Underwear Drawer is an otome visual novel, in which young Hana finds eternal love... or death! After a long time, Hana is single again. The breakup with her boyfriend Jan has hit her quite hard.

title: Autumn Park Mini Golf
description: Autumn Park Mini Golf is a first person miniature golf game set in a scenic park. With smooth jazz and piano sets to help set the mood, we think you'll enjoy your time relaxing and exploring the park while you play. Can you finish the game under par?

title: Laser Lasso Ball
description: Laser Lasso Ball is the deadliest sport in the universe. Beings from across the galaxy battle to become stars in this Local Multiplayer Alien Deathsport.

title: The Last Sniper VR
description: Travel back in time to WW2 and experience what it was like to fight as a soldier in room space Virtual Reality. The Last Sniper aims to simulate the sounds, visuals and feel of what it might have been like to be a soldier in a truly massive and horrifying war.

title: Star Explorers
description:
Earth is gone ... Humanity is faced with extinction ... Our only hope is to find another world.

Star Explorers is a game that randomly generates a galaxy. Each star and and celestial object can be scanned and added to an ever expanding database, every planet can be landed on and explored.

title: Osy Osmosis
description: Osy Osmosis is a fun game for all ages where you must help Osy stay safe as she navigates through her world collecting stars. To help Osy, you will use osmosis to keep her in balance with the world around her.

title: Lost Socks: Naughty Brothers
description: Set off in chase of the lost Sock! Lost Socks: Naughty Brothers is a brand new platformer set in a crazy world, with infinite fun and hardcore challenges. What sets this game apart is that the main character simply can’t stop, so the onslaught of enemies, barbs and bullets will be intense!

title: Puzzle Blocks
description: Puzzle Blocks is a creative puzzle game with beautiful minimalistic presentation.

title: Stars
description: 《Stars》is a VR game about stars. you can completely relax, look up at the sky and listen to the story of each constellation.

title: Blue Solar: Chaos War
description: Introducing Blue Solar: Chaos War, a roguelike sci-fi space adventure. Become a trader, pirate, adventurer and more. Shape a randomly generated universe. Invest in economies, engage in war, and compete for planets for your chosen government. Unite the universe, or lay waste to it all.

title: My Own Pet
description: "My Own Pet" is a game in which you will find an animal that will need you care for him and help to grow.

title: SOS: Special Operative Stories
description: These are the tense, action-packed stories of a special operative's past.

title: Torch Cave
description: Help Mr. Bravado retrieve the ancient artifact from Torch Cave and more importantly - help him get out of there alive!

title: Dropship Down
description: Dropship Down is a fun and intense twin-stick alien shooter for up to four players.

title: Francisca
description: Today my parents went to Mexico for a week, and I’m gonna have to spend seven days alone in our new house.

title: Reed
description:
Reed - is a small creature, the latest creation of the old supercomputer.
Old supercomputer dies, he has lost all of the cubes and he began to slow down...
Without a supercomputer, around the game world will come to an end.
Can you help him?...

title: The Orb Chambers II
description:
WARNING: THIS GAME REQUIRES SKILL. 
The Orb Chambers 2 is a brutally hard physics puzzle plat-former expanding on the original to make it better in every way possible. 
The game now includes MUCH more content, improved graphics and plenty of new features!

title: Don't Disturb
description: “Don't Disturb” is a single-player puzzle adventure game with a beautiful and unique 2D style. The carefully crafted story explores the traditional Asian views on the afterlife and the underworld.

title: HOVR
description: Feel the exhilarating adrenaline of virtual reality in this multiplayer & competitive car combat game. Get on your hoverbike and team up with a friend to battle your enemies through a hardcore and challenging gameplay in amazing cyberpunk arenas.

title: StoneBack | Prehistory
description: Immerse yourself in prehistoric world of adventures and dangers!

title: Star Project
description: STAR PROJECT - it's a great opportunity to meet new species and demonstrate superiority of the earthlings over all other populated worlds. Meet with unprecedented aggressive-minded space races and crush their best pilots! Your task is to destroy any military flotilla, which only meet in the deep space. Well, if you fulfilled your duty to humanity with dignity, if you stay alive after fulfillment of its most important task, the honor and glory will cover you and your home at all times.

title: Totem
description: Totem is a contemplative and spiritual experience in which you successively embody three totem animals: a bird, a wolf, and an elephant. Each animal represents a stage of an inner journey, guiding the player through the memories and emotions that shape a lifetime.

title: Sig.Null
description: This is a remake and expansion of an earlier PuzzleScript game, Signal. What I thought was so brilliant about the original is that while the rules never change, the level design is such that your ability to fully comprehend and exploit those rules shifts radically over time

title: Hikikomori No Chuunibyou
description: Hikikomori No Chuunibyou is a pseudo 8-bit platform-adventure game with beat-em-up, puzzle, and stealth elements. With its storytelling directing the player through open-ended levels, progression through each stage requires usage of parkour-like abilities and martial-arts techniques.

title: Rogue Islands
description: Rogue Islands is a fast-paced, first-person shooter with magic & monsters set in a procedural fantasy wilderness. Explore forests, deserts, caves and mountains. Gain in power as you eradicate a demonic horde and inch closer to the Lords of Torment.

title: Zumbi Blocks
description: Build your own defense base with your friends in the quarantine zone and survive against zombies!

title: Hopping Up for It
description: A magician has stored a rabbit in his enchanted top hat. Inside the hat is a pocket dimension he uses for storage. But the rabbit can smell a bag of carrots outside... help the rabbit hop out, for freedom and carrots! As you hop ever-upwards in this challenging game, you can save any time.

title: Fast and Curious
description: Fast and Curious is an online and local videogame for 2 players with funny and addictive gameplay.

title: Endangered
description: A first person shooter in a realistic setting.

title: Extravaganza Rising
description:
Fortune favors those bold enough to collect and train tiny monsters.

Three brave souls boldly descend into a town ridden with monsters, allies and everything in between. Driven only by the promise of powerful trinkets, unlimited treasure and almost certain death, they venture on.

title: Emerland Solitaire: Endless Journey
description: Welcome to Emerland Solitaire, the land of card magic! An incredible journey awaits you, in a beautiful world filled with dwarfs, elves, mermaids and many other amazing creatures.

title: C.S.S. Citadel VR
description: Are you ready to survive and escape from the C.S.S. Citadel?

title: Design it, Drive it: Speedboats
description: It's like a flight simulator for boats: Design and drive your own speedboats with simulation quality physics including blowover/chine walk/porpoising dynamics. 25+ adjustable design parameters. Free drive anywhere or compete on courses through leaderboards.

title: Mount Wingsuit
description: Welcome to Mount Wingsuit, where the thrill of hurtling down a mountain side in immersive VR with fast-paced arcade style gameplay will keep you in the zone for hours at a time.

title: Clock Simulator
description: Click once a second. Every second. You are the clock.

title: Acan's Call: Act 1
description: Sword and Shield in hand, fight your way along this sword-fighting experience, exclusively for VR.

title: Axis Football 2016
description: Axis Football is a an American football simulation featuring innovative aimed passing and massive customization.

title: Robots in the Wild
description: Robots In The Wild is a challenging puzzle/strategy game about creatively dropping Blocks to build Robot fortresses. Travel to distant planets and construct huge, interconnected Robot strongholds to protect and rescue the HEARTS from the Monsters of the Wild.

title: Venture Forth
description: Venture Forth is an extremely challenging adventure game with a retro 90s shooter vibe. Forge your own path within its labyrinthine caves but beware the danger lurking around every corner.

title: Uncorporeal: Alcatraz Island Lofts
description: "Alcatraz Island Lofts", an experimental VR short, is a dark comedy monologue set in 2025 San Franciso that imagines a rather cynical solution to San Francisco's housing crisis: converting the historic prison on Alcatraz Island into over-priced lofts. Run length is 1 min 30 secs.

title: Riddles of the Past
description: Riddles Of The Past is a Hidden Object game with detective story and post apocalyptic atmosphere.

title: House of Alice
description: The latest release of Indie game House of Alice is now available on Steam! Explore new scenes and characters. Unlike many VR games, this virtual bunny hunt starts out in a beautiful real-looking house. You can pick up vases and candlesticks and throw them around for an exciting crash or chase after the rabbits to collect points. Like Alice in Wonderland, this family-friendly game explores shifting perspectives of large and small and you can jump through the looking glass for surreal adventures.

title: Football VR
description: Anyone can throw a football on Earth. With FOOTBALL VR, step into a new world where you are the quarterback. Throw the football and race against the clock to score as many points as possible while you go for fame and try to reach our high score leaderboard.

title: Get the Gems
description:
Oldschool game in the style of Boulder Dash / Emerald Mine.
No fancy graphics, no high resolution, no holding hands.

title: Kuraburo Kai
description:
Kuraburo kai has been designed to maximize the brisk and easy feeling of blasting through blocks to your heart's content. 
In this unique block-breaker, you can charge up your Shuriken to launch piercing throws, or use your Ninjyutu skills to blast through obstacles.

title: GI Racing 2.0
description: Experience the thrill of GI Racing 2.0! Race your way through career mode collecting trophies and earning contracts with more prestigious racing teams. Unlock and drive new cars with different capabilities, perfect for enjoying the different weather, visibility, day/night and dynamic track conditions.

title: Enigma Prison
description:
Combine the mechanics of four unique tools to explore a scientific facility and expose its secrets.
Your play style will shape your adventure in this world full of mysteries to uncover. Learn with your mistakes and evolve to escape from this unique mind prison.

title: Secret Santa
description: Sneak around children, pets, and the elderly as you deliver Christmas joy. Complete the list of deliveries, and have some cookies.

title: Jockey Rush
description: Take the role of a jockey and ride racecourses around the world aiming to build your reputation and become the No.1. jockey!

title: Rogue Fighter
description: Take control of your space superiority fighter. Guide your ship to victory through randomly generated onslaughts of enemies and bosses. In this fast paced room scale experience,  your ship is only as good as your dexterity.

title: Copter and Sky
description: You will control a modern RC hexacopter in different gamemodes!

title: Ultimate Booster Experience
description: Take a ride on a huge 200m (600ft) swing with breathtaking views or try other height challenges! A vast modern city is your playground. Height and speed are your passion. Ultimate height experience for VR!

title: Redswood VR
description: Redswood VR is a virtual retelling of the Red Riding Hood story. In this tale, you play as both Red and then the Huntsman, each separately tasked with making their way through a dying and unrecognizable forest from their pasts to the inevitable conclusion at Granny's house.

title: Pulse Shift
description: Crazy physics toy with various of abilities such as gravity and time manipulation in many abstract levels.

title: Shinrai: Broken Beyond Despair
description:
A secluded mountain resort, 10 friends, 1 murderer.
Investigate, interrogate and present evidence as you solve various mysteries throughout the night. Will you be able to reach the truth and uncover the culprit’s identity? Or will your deductions lead you to blame someone completely innocent...?

title: Ascension VR
description:
Now updated with the War of Shadows expansion and support for motion controls! Come try out the expansion with the devs, Tuesday nights at 8pm Pacific.

Ascension VR is the first deckbuilding Virtual Reality experience. Bringing the tabletop world into one virtual space, Ascension VR uses 3D fully animated avatars and showcases social elements including spatialized voice chat, avatar lip sync and avatar animation triggered by real time player movement.

title: The Sunset
description:
When a person becomes too lazy to perform his functions, he comes up with all sorts of simplification. 
Mankind has invented them - aim to simplify your life. Mechanoids had to perform all kinds of activities. 
And at some point completely replace humans in the workspace.But slowly make the perfect workers, the people made a mistake. 
This mistake cost the lives of more than 80% of the world population, because the mechanoids are out of control - they began to kill everything that moves. 
 
For the time mechanoids held on our mortal planet, they have changed a lot. Now most of the planet surrounded by rocks. 
Floating in the air dust from the destroyed buildings. The mechanoids themselves become covered with stone chips. 
And they began to build their structures, which are called hives. Hives transform the earth into a more useful resource for mechanoid - stone. 
With which they build their world. 
 
But not all the people died. So raise all the forces to defeat what we have created!

title: Cubic complex
description: The game develops thinking and coordination. Collect all the keys on the map and find the exit. Use the second screen to find all the keys.

title: Glider Island
description: Put your gliding skills to the test in 3 vibrant landscapes each with their own magical looks and feel. Collect all hoops placed around each island before your time is up. Use your rocket boosters to keep from falling from the sky and avoid the dangers each map tosses your way! Designed for VR.

title: Gazzel Quest: The Five Magic Stones
description:
Gazzel is the bravest warrior of the armies of Pharaoh.
So tired of war, he decides to finish a life full of struggle and death.
But Pharaoh, furious with the decision of leaving by his best warrior, kidnaps his beloved Salama and orders to be imprisoned behind the Asorom door.
Asorom's door is sealed with the five sacred locks.
To open it, Gazzel must gather the five magical jewels.
Once all the jewels were placed in the five locks, the door will open and Samala will be free.
Every stone is kept by an underworld demon.
Our brave hero begins a dangerous journey through the five worlds with the only goal of bringing the five jewels together and open the evil door that retains his love.

title: Wildlife VR
description: A virtual reality hunting game, where you can shoot ducks, a deer, a boar, cans and TVs.

title: Holiday Flight Simulator
description: Ready for Take off is a flying simulator which makes it especially easy to relive the last holiday trip from the cockpit's view, even for less experienced pilots.

title: Epic Flail
description: Epic Flail is a fast paced 2D brawler with a gladiator theme that mimics the action packed fighting scenes from Japanese anime. Epic Flail has the player trapped in the arena, fighting through different modes and defeating other arena legends and even the gods themselves.

title: Weather Lord: Legendary Hero - Collector's Edition
description:
Call upon the gods of Olympus to help you rescue your beloved before all hope is gone! Unfolding with the scope of an epic fantasy adventure, Weather Lord: Legendary Hero - Collector's Edition will capture your imagination even as it draws you into hours of compelling gameplay!

This Collector's Edition includes;
- A huge bonus chapter
- A step-by-step walkthrough of the game
- Downloadable wallpapers
- Music
- Character bios
- An exclusive mini-game
- Dozens of challenging levels!

title: Ben and Ed: Blood Party
description: Welcome to the Blood Party! Play together with up to 3 people and compete in deadly game shows. Customize your zombie, build your own levels, share them via Steam Workshop and die a lot.

title: A Tale of Caos: Overture
description: An epic journey begins! Terry, a brilliant, messy girl, is beginning her greatest adventure, following her master, Albion McMaster, whose goals are quite dark and mysterious. With Heimlich, her mechanical owl and best friend, Terry will travel through amazing worlds and many unpredictable dangers!

title: Quack Attack 1985
description: Duckster doesn't give a crap about any one or any thing.

title: Final Fleet
description: A lone interstellar fleet must travel across a distant and perilous galaxy in the hope of reaching safety. Final Fleet is a Virtual Reality fleet building, space shooter.

title: VR Multi-Games
description: Play several original minigames designed for VR. This free collection of minigames is designed specifically for VR from the start, and provides original games and experiments for people to try.

title: Uncorporeal: Fluffy!
description: "Fluffy!", an experimental VR short, is pure camp horror with a script based loosely on the iconic 80's horror film "An American Werewolf in London". A surrealistic motel is imagined in the world of the original film, starring a peculiar bellmen who's obsessed with "pets'. Run length is 1 min 30 secs.

title: SoulHunt
description: SoulHunt is a ‘Hide ‘n Seek’ multiplayer game.

title: Kitty Cat: Jigsaw Puzzles
description:
Kitty Cat: Jigsaw Puzzles is the puurfect game to cat lovers and jigsaw puzzle game enthusiasts. The game includes 84 challenging jigsaw puzzles with beautiful pictures of sweet, irresistible and adorable cats and kittens.

There are 4 levels of difficulty adding to the fun. Puzzles will increase in size with additional pieces to place, and the quicker you solve each puzzle, the better star rating you will get. Are you up for the challenge?

title: Limberjack
description: Known to chainsaw-wielding loggers around the world as ‘limbing’, the art of stripping felled trees of their branches is exciting, but very dangerous. Welcome to Limberjack! Grab your Husqvarna chainsaw, and pursue your dream of becoming the undisputed greatest limber alive.

title: 39 Days to Mars
description:
39 Days to Mars is a co-operative (and single-player) steampunk puzzle-adventure game.

Step into the shoes of Sir Albert Wickes and The Right Honourable Clarence Baxter, two 19th century explorers who have chosen to pilot the HMS Fearful on its maiden voyage to Mars.

When the steam engine runs out of coal, the ship's cat shreds the navigation chart, and the tea gets cold, it becomes clear that interstellar transportation isn't a walk in the park. It will take the talents of two players working together on the problems that arise to get to Mars in one piece.

title: Pixel Puzzles 2: Radical Roach
description: Pixel Puzzles 2: Radical Roach is a traditional style jigsaw puzzle game in a Radical style.

title: Castle Invasion: Throne Out
description: Castle Invasion: Throne Out is an action arcade game about the fun, frantic challenge of defending your castle against an army of misfits. Who better to lead the army than the king, a spoiled man child who wants everything he can’t have? Well... he's not taking this castle.

title: Brick Stack VR
description: Surround yourself by three walls of falling bricks as you work as fast as you can to clear them.

title: Save the Universe, Please!
description: Take command of the crew of the ESS Shyp, explore planets, and deal with friendship, betrayal and maybe love! It's up to you to Save the Universe! It's your choice, so Please, don't let the Universe down!

title: Fist of Physics
description: Punch a robot in the face! Robots are running wild in San Francisco. Fight through multiple rounds against different opponents to save the city. Fist of Physics uses Midas’ VR physics to let players literally reach out and touch their opponent. Every response and movement looks real.

title: The Return Home
description: The house of a rabbit has been attacked by reptiles from another dimension and they prepare occupation of the planet by means of portals. Whether the rabbit will be able to fight back reptiles and to return the house?

title: Kisaragi no Hougyoku
description:
Fujiwara Toru is a transfer student. At first glance he seems to be a generic, awkward teenager, but there is more to him than meets the eye.

Sangu academy has a tradition called Ren. each year student choose a different grade partner, and all non partnered people are alone.

title: The Cold War Era
description: The Cold War Era is strategy game based on the historical conflict between the USA and the USSR

title: The Cooking Game
description: Start The Cooking Game, learn to cook, serve and manage your own restaurants. Show your skills and feed the hungry customers!

title: Rage of the Battlemage
description: Dark atmosphere and beautifull graphic - Rage of the Battlemage

title: Along the Edge
description: Along the Edge is a visual novel set in the European countryside, where your choices impact the main character's personality and appearance.

title: Optika
description:
Discover the world of light physics: play with lasers, prisms, mirrors, magnets and dozens of other optical devices.
Explore the world of Optika with Prof. Opticus and his assistant, Sofia! Research and complete more than one hundred challenging puzzles!

title: Escape from Pleasure Planet
description: Escape from Pleasure Planet is a gay-themed science-fiction adventure game with bright colourful graphics, a fun story and character art by Joe Phillips.

title: Malazard: The Master of Magic
description:
Unleash the magic inside you!
Purify the demonic legion with a set of powerful abilities.
The collapsing world relies upon you, experience what it means to become the Master Of Magic!

title: StarSmashers
description: You are Captain Carter, of the Space Beagle. Ahead lies an army lead by the scumbag Kaldor Seth, he will obliterate all who oppose him in his pursuit of power. Carefully manage your ships weapons and defenses to bring your enemies to their knees!

title: Team Racing League
description: Team Racing League is the first team-based racing game where you win and lose together as a team.

title: Salvaged
description: The human race explores the stars, but a keen focus on the future has left a trail of desolation in the past. You are Alex Pieterson, commander of the salvage ship Thaddeus and its team of hardened agents. You are a remnant of that past, fighting for survival in a huge new galaxy.

title: Hover Havoc
description: Grab 3 friends, 4 controllers and pick your craft... then battle, bump and bounce opponents into ‘hoverific’ submission! A fun fueled pickup 'n play party game; drift through a multitude of arenas in a blur of hover-fueled rampage!

title: The Unwelcomed
description: The Unwelcomed is an escape the room (EtR) type game created for VR and was inspired by such classics as Crimson Room. The Unwelcomed starts by inviting you to come to your late uncle's mansion to claim it as your own. Once you arrive, however, it's going to be hard to leave...

title: SaberSaw VR
description: Take the role of warrior controlling giant SaberSaws to defend yourself from waves of ever more challenging bots.

title: Grid Legion, Storm
description: You are a conjurer voyaging Mythos. Explore an easy to learn but difficult to master strategy card game.

title: Tears Revolude
description:
A classic command-based RPG with 3D map interface and smooth battle animation!
A century ago, there was a unique artist named Orwiel. Sion and Michelle set off on a journey to discover his final works. The two meet a girl with no memories named Liara. What the girl carries will shake both the path they travel and their fate!

title: Faria: Ghosts of the Stream
description: Heed the Song of the Wild and join Fiona Lightspyre as she embarks upon a journey northwards. Along the way, she'll make acquaintances, forge friendships and face much peril in her quest to "upstream". This is a Happy Fantasy.

title: Woven
description: Explore a seemingly safe and woven world where stuffed animals live. Continuously re-knit & customize your character to solve puzzles.

title: Lew Pulsipher's Doomstar
description:
Doomstar, the hidden unit board game of strategy and cunning, is a new exclusive release from Large Visible Machine and
legendary designer Lew Pulsipher (Britannia, Dragon Rage, Sea Kings).

Play the AI or against friends or online opponents with fully asynchronous online multiplayer.

title: Slavistan
description:
Hello Comrades ! You think you got what it takes to be tru slav?
Then we have game for you ! Prove to all your gopnik friends
that you are the superior alpha slav your babushka always wanted you to be.

title: Doodle What?!
description: A Twitch.tv integrated social drawing game.

title: Destiny of Ancient Kingdoms
description: Destiny of Ancient Kingdoms (DOAK) is a free, action MMORPG based on the legends of Norse Mythology. An epic story-line, action-packed combat and classic multiplayer roleplaying elements await strong warriors who are courageous enough to enter the New World!

title: Mushroom Crusher Extreme
description: Mushroom Crusher Extreme is a retro-styled arcade-action game, that throws you right in the heart of a giant Shroom invasion. Fight off the vicious fungi with elemental magic and save the day, before it’s too late.

title: Barnyard Mahjong 3
description: Barnyard Mahjong 3 takes you on a grand adventure around the farm playing challenging mahjong puzzles with farm-inspired animals such as horses, cows and chickens.

title: The Hidden Dragon
description: Fugo Rojo the Dragon loves to collect manmade objects and his eternal taste for treasure takes him on a journey to collect items from around the world.

title: Mystery of Rivenhallows
description: Mystery Of Rivenhallows is an exciting adventure game full of mystery and suspense paying homage to the classic genre of point-and-click adventure gaming.

title: Dragon Rage
description: Fast-paced destruction! Tear the #!@$ out of a mountain-top village as the King sends out his royal army to try to stop you and protect his kingdom. The more villagers you devour, the stronger you get. Fill your belly and enter Rampage Mode where you can unleash mass destruction!

title: Jurassic Survival
description: Jurassic Survival is an open-world survival game where players must cohabit with roaming dinosaurs.

title: Of Love and Sorrow
description: Of Love And Sorrow is a 120,000 word interactive novel following the story of two young brothers from the South, separated by war, love and betrayal. Starting with their ambition to become officers at the Westpoint Academy, the choices you make will direct the story - their lives, their loves, their very destiny is up to you.

title: Trolley Gold
description: Do you want to collect all the gold in the world? The game "Trolley Gold" gives you this opportunity!

title: Cats are Liquid: A Light in the Shadows
description: Cats are Liquid is a minimalistic 2D platformer about a cat with the ability to transform into liquid.

title: Shards of Azuria
description:
Shards of Azuria is an isometric, craft and build RPG. Create a character and a new world, then start your adventure by waking up in town. You are greeted by the locals of Azuria and begin to find your way around. 
 
The inhabitants of Azuria will assist you on your journey, helping you obtain many Abilities or to satisfy your creative endeavour. Wander into the unknown, build a home and become strong enough to face the lurking evil.

title: Puzzle Nebula
description: Puzzle Nebula is a mind-bending puzzle game set in the far corners of space.

title: Basketball Court VR
description: Basketball Court VR offers a relaxing, casual basketball shooting simulation for those who prefer to have the court all by themselves. The game offers 5 game modes in either indoor or outdoor scenario.

title: AquaNimble
description: AquaNimble is about crazy intense shooter action with big quirky guns against underwater snake dragons, cybernetic sharks, swirling skeletons, submarines and so much more. It's a dynamic game that makes every play through different and lets you set your own challenge beyond a difficulty setting.

title: Remnants of the Arcane
description: Play as an Arcanist and use spells to solve puzzles while looking for the way out. Don't let yourself be killed by traps or the things living inside the ruins of the Order of the Arcane.

title: A Week of Circus Terror
description:
A hand-drawn, point & click indie horror game about the haunted house and his owner.
During the day, you have to search for some informations, but when the night comes, you have to understand, why are the possessed toys trying to kill you. You have to find a way to go through them and save your life!

title: Abduction Episode 1: Her Name Was Sarah
description: You wake up in the middle of the night and realize you’re not alone. Armed with your wits, make it through your apartment and survive the ABDUCTION.

title: Switch 'N' Shoot
description: An arcade shoot 'em up with just one button... Whenever you shoot, you also flip direction. Save the world with a single button!

title: I Am the Hero
description: I Am The Hero is a pixel art, beat 'em up, fighting game that tells the story of a "Hero" with a glorious but mysterious past. Is he the hero he thinks he is or is there a another side to this legendary figure?

title: Depths of Dread
description: There is something unusual about the source of monsters coming from the depths below. Having been summoned by the king to investigate a dungeon beneath an old abandoned town, you are to put together a team that will purge the dungeon of evil before it spreads and consumes the land.

title: Extreme Forklifting 2
description: Always dreamed of becoming a forklift operator? Now you can!

title: ASRECorp
description: Your company has discovered a machine that can transport people to different worlds and nightmares, as the newly appointed scientist you must discover the reason a machine that can take you to such places even exists.

title: Blortasia
description:
Blortasia is an abstract art world in the sky.  
Fly freely through a surreal maze of evolving sculptures. Take a break from reality and explore an animated psychedelic sculpture park. Blortasia combines art and flying in virtual reality.

title: D.N.Age
description: ‘D.N.Age’ features a DNA system that will open your eyes to a new, never-before-seen world of monster merging. Improve the DNA of your monsters to create stronger specimens and form a party to complete quests!

title: GravPool
description: A simulation of the version of billiards that space pilgrims played during the starship migrations of the 2300s. Instead of aiming for pockets on a flat plane, you have six degrees of freedom with which to aim your shots. There are some new obstacles that make things a little more chaotic. If you want to bend the laws of physics and get a little crazy, or are just interested in the historical significance of the game, GravPool may be up your alley.

title: Project Hovercraft
description: Project Hovercraft is a hovercraft combat game. At the start of a match, all players pick a hovercraft, then drive around, and blow each other up! Battle it out with your friends online over a variety of locations, game types, and of course; hovercrafts!

title: Crystal Quest Classic
description: Crystal Quest is a fast moving, adrenaline-boiling video arcade game from 1987 that won many awards. Now on the latest hardware.

title: Crimson Sword Saga: The Peloran Wars
description:
Crimson Sword Saga: The Peloran Wars is a RPG/visual novel which borrows many popular gameplay elements from series such as 
Fire Emblem and Langrisser. Times are hard in Pelora. Queen Jezebel rules the island of Belsar with an iron fist, aided by the relentless Empire. The brother-kings Kalan and Abel oppose the Empire on the mainland, but with few troops, their resistance is soon to falter. And there are rumors that the ancient cult of Brax has risen again to stir dark magics. Which faction will you choose to side with? From this important decision, the story splits into many very contrasting possibilities.

title: Agent Walker: Secret Journey
description: Find the Spear of Destiny to save the world!

title: Sapper's bad dream
description:
The bomberman's nightmare. Or is it not a dream?
Blow up the creatures before they try to kill you!

title: Trick & Treat
description: Trick & Treat is a Visual Novel that test your instincts by making choices that can get you out from the cursed forest or drive you to death… or maybe just maybe your choices can guide you to something more?

title: Line / Dash
description: LineDash is an arcade-oriented game that doubles as a procedural player-controlled multimedia sculpture. The basic gameplay is extremely simple, and only requires two buttons: The left click of your mouse will drop lines from the sky, while the right click will make those lines dash forward. As the pace of the opposition gets faster and the line start splitting and crossing LineDash becomes a hypnotic and ever-changing visual experience. And you can also get high scores and stuff if you really lean that way!

title: Plates
description: Plates is a minimalist puzzle game. Experiment and explore to progress through over 50 inventive levels.

title: Safety First!
description: Safety First! is a twin stick physics puzzler in which you have to fix broken electric wires using your Magical Yellow Repair Liquid (MYRL). Can you beat all 69 levels?

title: Funfair Ride Simulator 3
description:
Have you ever had the opportunity to control your own amusement ride at the fair? Probably not ...  
Now you can experience this on your PC & Mac with the new Funfair Ride Simulator 3. With physics and detailed graphics, awesome fog, firework and light effects and a simulated fairground.

title: ReCursed
description:
Another day on the job as a live-streamer, you've recently downloaded ReCursed, a seemingly harmless escape room puzzle game. With the help of your moderators, you begin to entertain your fans while playing. But as you delve deeper into the game's dark, twisted levels of inception, you realize everything looks eerily familiar. Something is not right.

The game's horrors are no longer just pixels on a screen — they're bleeding into reality.

If you die in the game, would you die in real life?

title: Ayumi: Enhanced Edition
description: A space horror adventure, featuring Lovecraftian Yellow themes.

title: Golden Krone Hotel
description: Golden Krone Hotel is a gothic horror roguelike. Fight vampires with sunlight or become a vampire yourself and sneak in the shadows. Combines classic turn-based combat with dynamic lighting, an innovative potion system, and fast paced gameplay.

title: Quanero
description: Quanero is an experimental VR experience for the HTC Vive and the Oculus Rift. Your goal is to figure out what caused a violent incident in a futuristic bar by manipulating the time. You can slow down time, reverse it or bring it to a halt. Explore the scene, unlock the story's branch points and unravel the mystery.

title: Zezenia Online
description: Zezenia Online is a growing free-to-play 2D MMORPG. Large map with 4 continents, hundreds of spells, monsters and quests to explore with 7 subclasses.

title: Always Higher
description: Always Higher is a single-player sci-fi adventure shooter VR game. Play as a secret agent, collect data modules, avoid enemy soldiers and escape underground facility!

title: Conclusion
description: The story of the Nile. Man, being in an unknown place. How did he get here? What is this place? Why this road seems very familiar? All questions have to answer You.

title: Rise
description: RISE is a first-person vignette by Dr Dakoda Barker about living with chronic health conditions. The narrative is simple – the player has to get out of bed, get dressed and leave their house for the day. But Barker expresses the complexities of living with chronic illness by implementing intentionally hostile game design. The controls are unwieldy and incredibly demanding, forcing the player to use the controller in unexpected ways, to ask someone near them to help with the controls – or to make more conservative choices, like being too exhausted to bother with cool boots and settle for simple canvas sneakers instead. RISE’s challenging controls are designed to give the player insight into the physicality of living with chronic illness and pain, and the constant domestic negotiations that come with it.

title: 1 Moment of Time: Silentville
description: 1 Moment Of Time: Silentville is a casual adventure with hidden objects and logical puzzles.

title: Pixelscape: Oceans
description: Pixelscape: Oceans gives users the tools to sketch and build animated oceanscapes, and then fill them with a number of different sea creatures. Save, share, and download an unlimited amount of custom underwater content. The possibilities are as endless as the seas.

title: G Prime into the Rain
description: A gravity gripping, steampunk-styled, moody-beautiful, slingshot simulating puzzle pleaser. If you like Gravity Sling, Blast Off or Gears of Gravity, you’ll love this game.

title: Maze Roller
